description: List the available option expiration dates for <symbol>. Returns an array of YYYY-MM-DD dates you can pass to tradier_option_chain. Example: tradier_option_expirations({ symbol: "AAPL", _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: Tradier access token (free with a funded Tradier brokerage account, or a sandbox token)

sandbox.description: Use the Tradier sandbox environment (sandbox.tradier.com) instead of production. Default false.

name: tradier_option_expirations
